versions.changelog:
Initial release of backend-interview-designer skill:

- Generates senior-level backend interview questions by topic, covering API design, distributed systems, caching, security, and more.
- Outputs one scenario-based question per request, with a concise note on what’s being evaluated.
- Includes scheduled variants for full architecture scenarios and deep theory questions, both general and Node.js/NestJS-specific.
- Questions emphasize production realism, partial failures, trade-offs, and operational constraints.
- No pure definitions or follow-up questions; focus remains on high-signal, judgment-based interview questions.
